annotations.title: Search UGC and social comments across the web

description: Search the web for user-generated content: what real people say about a product, problem or audience in comments on Reddit, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook groups. Runs a full live search: finds threads and videos across the web, reads their comments, extracts verbatim quotes and writes a cited answer. A query that contains a TikTok video, creator profile or hashtag link, a bare creator @handle (TikTok unless the query says YouTube), a YouTube video or channel link, a Reddit thread or subreddit link, or a Facebook group post link reads that link's own comments directly (add a question after the link to also search the topic). A query that is a pasted list of comments is analyzed directly with no web search. A search usually takes one to three minutes, longer than one call can wait: it waits up to `wait_seconds` and returns the answer with the top quotes when done, otherwise the exact `get_search` call to make next; keep calling `get_search` until the status is completed. Costs credits from the BuzzSearch balance at the API rate; the exact charge is reported on completion as `credits_charged` with `balance_after`. When the balance cannot cover a search the call fails with INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS and a top-up link: tell the user and share the link. Check `list_searches` first: a prior search on the same topic can be reread for free.

depth.description: quick (about a minute), deep (about three), exhaustive (longest, most comments).

query.description: The research question, e.g. 'what do people hate about robot vacuums'.

sources.description: Default: reddit, youtube, tiktok. Add facebook for group discussions.

time_range.description: How recent the posts and comments should be. Default: any time.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

name: search
